title.narrative: Prevention of Female Circumcision in West Java

description.narrative:
The Project’s expected effect(s) on society (Impact) is elimination of the practice of female circumcision as part of eradication of violence against women and violation of human rights more systematically in three regions of West Java: Bogor, Cianjur and Tasikmalaya.
Outcome 1 Perspective and narratives/arguments for eradication of female circumcision in the framework of human rights based on progressive religious views are accepted and disseminated by organizations, activists, preachers and religious leaders, both national and local. Outputs: 1.1 Availability of handbook on what female circumcision is and why it must be prohibited based on feminist cultural arguments in the framework of upholding human rights. 1.2 Dissemination of handbook on: a) why female circumcision must be prohibited, b) KUPI (Indonesian Congress of Women Ulema) fatwa (recommendation), fatwas of other credible institutions that state female circumcision is haram, c) rules of the state on prohibition of female circumcision, d) results of study of the Muslim feminist movement on reinterpretation of misogynistic religious views that subordinate women and perpetuate female circumcision. 1.3 Availability of informational materials in the form of creative and easy-to-read works for cadres/community outreach workers, ustadzah/religious outreach workers, midwives and healthcare personnel in the three target regions.
Outcome 2 Organizations and advocates raise awareness and conduct advocacy for prevention and eradication of female circumcision using feminist cultural arguments in the framework of human rights based on progressive religious views. Outputs: 2.1 Policy brief is formulated as material for advocacy with local governments and legislatures in the three regions for continuing advocacy for prevention of female circumcision. 2.2 Policy brief is conveyed in dialogues and hearings with local governments and legislatures in the three regions.
